svg.title: 1. CI/CD and GitOps reference architecture
svg.text: CI/CD and GitOps on AWS: build once, sign, promote by pull request
CodePipeline builds and signs one image per commit. Argo CD pulls the desired state from Git into each account. Nothing outside a cluster holds production kubeconfig.
Argo CD polls Git every 3 min and also takes a webhook, so a merge
usually lands within seconds. selfHeal reverts manual drift.
and Prometheus every 60 s during a canary
every cluster pulls images by digest
